name: What are common signs of moisture in a basement that needs addressing before painting?

mainEntity.name: What are common signs of moisture in a basement that needs addressing before painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs of moisture in a basement include a musty odor, visible mold or mildew growth, water stains on walls or floors, damp spots, peeling or bubbling paint, and efflorescence (white powdery residue) on concrete surfaces. If you notice any of these indicators, it's critical to identify and resolve the source of the moisture before undertaking any painting project. Painting over these issues will only hide them temporarily and lead to future paint failure.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for musty odors, mold, water stains, damp spots, peeling paint, or efflorescence. Address these moisture signs before painting to prevent future problems.
